blind_submission_boundary.meaning: This file is the independent first-round raw-first proposal and is not a FINAL decision.

excluded_inputs: old Judge audit outputs outside the frozen raw scope

blind_signature.algorithm: For each component, sort relative file paths bytewise; emit sha256sum for each file in that order; hash the resulting lines. Aggregate the three component signature lines in fixed listed order and hash them.

findings.title: Baseline reviewer-visible records expose provider and model identity together with prompts

raw_paths.pointers: All 162 record.json files contain all six fields; line positions are stable in the representative schema.

source_refs.reason: The closure identifies the frozen NL and PlantUML inputs corresponding to the baseline records.

findings.reason: The frozen baseline artifact exposes the model/provider/profile identity and the full prompts in the same reviewer-visible record as the adjudication payload. A fairness reviewer can therefore infer arm or provider provenance from fields unrelated to the semantic evidence, even without making a provider call.
findings.basis: Raw-only inspection found 162/162 records with configured_model, observed_model, profile, provider, system_prompt, and user_prompt. The representative record also exposes the absolute NL/PlantUML source paths and hashes at lines 28-32.
findings.recompute_command: find raw/x1v2_baseline/method -type f -name record.json -print0 | xargs -0 jq -r 'select(has("configured_model") and has("observed_model") and has("profile") and has("provider") and has("system_prompt") and has("user_prompt"))|1' | wc -l
findings.targeted_re_review: Create a reviewer-visible projection that removes provider, model, profile, adapter, prompt, and provider-specific path hints while retaining opaque pair/round IDs and source hashes; re-run the same 162-record field scan and a blinded sample over all 54 pairs x 3 rounds. PASS requires zero exposed provider/model/profile fields in the projection and preserved source-byte hashes.

findings.title: Current source-run manifests expose the selected model profile to a reviewer

source_refs.reason: Each manifest identifies the same model profile while covering 54 pairs in one round.

findings.reason: The current-side run manifest places the model profile next to the pair and round selection metadata. This allows provider/model-conditioned expectations or post-hoc stratification by run, weakening a provider-free fairness review even though the current audit bundles themselves contain no provider_calls field.
findings.basis: All 3 current run manifests report model_profile=gpt-5.6-luna at line 14, with 54 selected pair IDs and one selected round per manifest. The raw source-run component contains 654 files and is part of the frozen audit evidence tree.
findings.recompute_command: for f in raw/v60_current/judge/source_runs/*/run_manifest.json; do rg -n '"model_profile"|"selected_pair_ids"|"selected_rounds"' "$f"; done
findings.targeted_re_review: Move model/provider/profile identity to a sealed non-reviewer manifest or replace it with a stable opaque run token in the reviewer-visible tree. Re-run the manifest scan across all three runs and verify that the 54-pair x 3-round coverage and raw/source aggregate hashes remain unchanged.

findings.title: No direct adjudication or old-label marker found in the allowed raw/source scope
findings.reason: The allowed raw/source inputs do not contain the searched direct markers for manual adjudication, primary decision, reference label, or canonical decision.
findings.basis: Raw-first content scan returned zero matching files for all seven marker variants in each of the three allowed roots.
findings.recompute_command: for p in raw/v60_current raw/x1v2_baseline reference/x1v2_input_closure; do for pat in manual_adjudication primary_decision 'primary decision' reference_label 'reference label' canonical_decision 'canonical decision'; do rg -l -i --hidden --glob '*.json' --glob '*.md' --glob '*.txt' --glob '*.puml' "$pat" "$p"; done; done
findings.evidence_pointer: command result: 0 matching files for every marker variant in all three allowed roots
findings.targeted_re_review: Repeat the same marker scan after any projection change; any newly introduced direct label or decision marker is a FAIL and must be removed from the reviewer-visible scope.

findings.title: Input closure hashes match all copied NL and PlantUML files

source_refs.reason: The manifest states that copied inputs are checked against the frozen record hashes.

findings.reason: Every manifest-listed copied NL and PlantUML file independently recomputed to the manifest hash.
findings.basis: 108/108 hash checks passed and 0 failed for the 54 input keys, each with NL and PlantUML closure entries.
findings.recompute_command: jq -r '.inputs[][] | [.repository_path,.sha256] | @tsv' reference/x1v2_input_closure/manifest.json | while IFS=$'\t' read -r p expected; do actual=$(sha256sum "$p" | awk '{print "sha256:"$1}'); test "$actual" = "$expected" && echo PASS || echo FAIL:$p:$expected:$actual; done | sort | uniq -c
findings.targeted_re_review: Recompute all 108 checks after any source projection or relocation; do not substitute a path-only check for the byte hash check.
